title: Size of multiple circuit vent.
officialText:
Each separate circuit-vented horizontal branch that is interconnected shall be sized
independently in accordance with Section 911.3. The downstream circuit-vented horizontal branch shall be sized for the total
discharge into the branch, including the upstream branches and the fixtures within the branch.
